## What's new

- **Pasting presets: no needless prompts.**
  - If the map already has the preset's tiles from another DT1 and they match pixel for pixel, the preset is placed straight away.
  - If some tiles look different, "Some tiles look different in this map" shows the map's version and the pasted version side by side for each one. Pick one per tile, or use "For all".
    - The map's version: nothing is added.
    - The pasted version: only those tiles go into a small DT1 under new numbers, so the map's existing tiles keep their look.
    - Tiles you don't pick, and identical ones, are left out.
- **Adding many DT1s at once:**
  - In the DT1 library, every folder has "choose all N", which chooses every library in it (and its subfolders) that the map doesn't load yet.
  - DT1s brought in with "+ Add DT1 files…" or "+ Add a folder…" and not added to the map straight away now come already chosen. One click on "Add N to the map" adds them all.
- **Walkability: change the tiles themselves (like WinDS1).** A new "Change" option in Walkability mode.
  - "The tiles themselves" changes the sub-tile flags in the tiles' own DT1s: no extra DT1, and it never runs out of room. Every cell, in every map, using those tiles changes too, and the panel says how many other cells of this map are affected.
  - Save tile flags writes the changes (originals kept as .bak); Discard takes them back.
  - "This map only" works as before. A cell whose two floor layers are both used can now still be blocked as a whole (Cell brush) with the map's own whole-cell flag, where it used to be skipped.
- **Edit a DT1 without a map:** Home → "Edit a DT1…" (and Map → DT1 editor) opens the DT1 editor with no map open. Pick any DT1 from the game or your mod to recolour it, paint it, make it act-safe, change tile settings and flags, or save a copy.
